Chapter 6496: Everlasting Drop

Chapter 6496: Everlasting Drop

Paragon took on the form of an immemorial true god while the everlasting nature of Paramount gradually condensed at a rapid rate instead of expanding.

It grew stronger and purer instead of weakening. Eventually, the massive Paramount became as small as a drop of water to everyone’s astonishment. The amount of life force within was terrifying.

“Bam!” The dream world lost its balance, unable to endure the weight of the drop. Everyone panicked due to the sudden destabilization.

“Cauldron of Truth!” The true god took action and transformed into a cauldron around Li Qiye, trapping him within.

The sea in the real world became affected by its existence, resulting in an apocalyptic scene.

“Everlasting Drop.” The drop of water from Paramount dripped into the cauldron, aiming straight for Li Qiye.

The mere droplet could strip everything it touched back to the origin regardless of its toughness. This included dao fruits and primal animas.

As the cauldron trapped Li Qiye, the eons of time and life forces crushed him. At the same time, the woman played another tune from her flute, focusing the notes on Li Qiye alone. This invisible force could mesmerize a primal ancestor and reduce them to dust.

Li Qiye faced three attacks at once. The laws and affinities around him melted like bones reduced to broth from intense heat.

None could survive while being trapped in this cauldron. Even the strongest cultivator would be reduced to broth without the chance to scream.

The members of Gold Village were in disarray, thinking that even their golden giant wouldn’t survive the onslaught of two major realms and an immortal artifact.

“Can you increase the heat?” A leisurely voice came from the cauldron.

He somehow stood inside the cauldron, completely unscathed. The woman and her allies became startled.

“Boil to reach the truth!” The primal ancestors burned themselves to accept more powers from Paragon and Paramount.

The cauldron became brighter with the extra influx, doubling in strength and showing no end in sight. The woman also played her flute faster, depleting her true blood and primal energy.

She wanted to drown Li Qiye with the song, not giving him a chance to resist. The flames from the furnace seemed capable of burning a true immortal. Unfortunately, it just didn’t work against Li Qiye.

They thought that even if it couldn’t kill him, it could still trap him within. After a few seconds, they realized his immunity.
